UsageMatcher
Summary
　EntisGLS4 の SUsageMatcher とほぼ同等です。
String[] param = new String[] ;
UsageMatcher usage = new UsageMatcher( "(%t) is (%t)" ) ;
if ( usage.parse( "apple is red", param ) == null )
{
    System.console().printf( "%s, %s", param[0], param[1] ) ; // apple, red
}
